URL: https://www.independent.ie/world-news/andy-burnham-unveils-tax-cut-on-electricity-ahead-of-first-cabinet-meeting/a/158988886.html
NOTE: PA copy (21 Jul 2026, 05:50) — VAT cut detail + Burnham quote; ahead of first Cabinet meeting. Ofgem price cap cut ~£45 from October.
Burnham: "Westminster has not been working for people for too long, with families struggling with the cost of [living]. That needs to change. I said I wanted to give people breathing space, and that's what I'm announcing on my second day as Prime Minister. We're taking immediate action to cut taxes on energy bills, put more money in people's pockets and bring back hope."
Estimated to cut annual Ofgem price cap by ~£45 from October; funded by cancelling the Digital ID programme. Rent controls and capping bus fares also being explored. Burnham chairs first Cabinet meeting Tuesday.
